headline: UK regulator wants Apple to open up iPhone NFC payment access
summary: A UK regulator is asking Apple to widen access to its iPhone payment technology, including NFC. The regulator says proposed changes could enable new digital wallets, keys and ticketing apps, in a move one outlet describes as targeting Apple's near-monopoly on contactless smartphone payments.

claims.statement: A UK regulator is pushing Apple to open up access to its iPhone NFC/contactless payment technology.
